---- MODULE ivy_examples_tlb ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_tlbDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
\* Phase predicates used by the safety invariant.  Keeping these as
\* predicates, rather than sets of labels, also keeps the SMT obligations
\* small.
AGPheld(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorForSend
  \/ c = InitiatorCheckCpuPmap
  \/ c = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorInterrupt
  \/ c = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence
  \/ c = InitiatorUpdateEntry
  \/ c = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockPmap
AGSending(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorForSend
  \/ c = InitiatorCheckCpuPmap
  \/ c = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorInterrupt
AGSelected(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorCheckCpuPmap
  \/ c = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorInterrupt
AGMatching(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorInterrupt
AGIown(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockAction
AGRown(c) ==
  \/ c = ResponderRefreshTlb
  \/ c = ResponderClearActionNeeded
  \/ c = ResponderUnlockAction
AGAfterSend(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence
  \/ c = InitiatorUpdateEntry
  \/ c = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockPmap
AGAfterWait(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorUpdateEntry
  \/ c = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockPmap
AGIinactive(c) ==
  \/ c = InitiatorLockPmap
  \/ c = InitiatorForSend
  \/ c = InitiatorCheckCpuPmap
  \/ c = InitiatorLockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorSetActionNeeded
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockAction
  \/ c = InitiatorInterrupt
  \/ c = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence
  \/ c = InitiatorUpdateEntry
  \/ c = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb
  \/ c = InitiatorUnlockPmap
  \/ c = InitiatorReactivate
AGRinactive(c) ==
  \/ c = ResponderLockAction
  \/ c = ResponderRefreshTlb
  \/ c = ResponderClearActionNeeded
  \/ c = ResponderUnlockAction
  \/ c = ResponderReactivate
AGRblocked(c) ==
  \/ c = ResponderCheck
  \/ c = ResponderDeactivate
  \/ c = ResponderLockAction
  \/ c = ResponderReactivate

\* A notified processor in one of these phases cannot perform a TLB check
\* before handling the notification.
AGBlocked(p) ==
  \/ AGRblocked(pc[p])
  \/ (interrupt[p] /\ (AGIinactive(pc[p]) \/ pc[p] = MainHandleInterrupt))
\* The two local intervals in which a refresh has not yet been performed.
AGDirty(p) ==
  \/ pc[p] = ResponderRefreshTlb
  \/ (pc[p] = InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb /\ userpmap[p] = writepmap[p])
\* In the send loop, removing a CPU from todo selects it; that CPU is
\* counted as sent only after its interrupt step has finished.  The second
\* loop reuses todo to record CPUs still awaiting quiescence.
AGSent(p,q) ==
  \/ AGAfterSend(pc[p])
  \/ (AGSending(pc[p]) /\ ~todo[p][q]
      /\ (pc[p] = InitiatorForSend \/ currentcpu[p] # q))
AGMarked(p,q) ==
  \/ AGSent(p,q)
  \/ (pc[p] \in {InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt} /\ currentcpu[p] = q)
AGQuiesced(p,q) ==
  \/ AGAfterWait(pc[p])
  \/ (pc[p] = InitiatorWaitForQuiescence /\ ~todo[p][q])
AGTypes ==
  /\ pc \in [Processor -> STRING]
  /\ userpmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ writepmap \in [Processor -> PMap]
  /\ currentcpu \in [Processor -> Processor]
  /\ actionlock \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actionneeded \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ active \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ interrupt \in [Processor -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ plock \in [PMap -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ tlb \in [Processor -> PageEntry]
  /\ pentry \in [PMap -> PageEntry]
  /\ todo \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
  /\ error \in BOOLEAN
AGActivity ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    (~active[p]) <=> (AGIinactive(pc[p]) \/ AGRinactive(pc[p]))
\* A held pmap lock has a unique initiating processor.
AGPmap ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor : AGPheld(pc[p]) => plock[writepmap[p]]
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (AGPheld(pc[p]) /\ AGPheld(pc[q]) /\ p # q)
       => writepmap[p] # writepmap[q]
\* Action-lock ownership, mutual exclusion, and absence of orphan locks.
AGAction ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor : AGRown(pc[p]) => actionlock[p]
  /\ \A p \in Processor : AGIown(pc[p]) => actionlock[currentcpu[p]]
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor :
       (AGIown(pc[p]) /\ AGIown(pc[q]) /\ p # q)
       => currentcpu[p] # currentcpu[q]
  /\ \A p \in Processor : AGIown(pc[p]) => ~AGRown(pc[currentcpu[p]])
  /\ \A p \in Processor : actionlock[p] =>
       (AGRown(pc[p]) \/ \E q \in Processor : AGIown(pc[q]) /\ currentcpu[q] = p)
AGTarget ==
  /\ \A p \in Processor : AGSelected(pc[p]) =>
       (currentcpu[p] # p /\ pc[currentcpu[p]] # Boot)
  /\ \A p \in Processor : AGMatching(pc[p]) =>
       userpmap[currentcpu[p]] = writepmap[p]
  /\ \A p,q \in Processor : AGSending(pc[p]) /\ todo[p][q] =>
       (p # q /\ pc[q] # Boot)
\* Facts retained from the marking, interrupt, and quiescence stages.
\* They apply only to other, booted CPUs using the affected pmap.
AGNotify ==
  \A p,q \in Processor :
    (p # q /\ pc[q] # Boot /\ userpmap[q] = writepmap[p]) =>
      /\ (AGMarked(p,q) => (actionneeded[q] /\ ~AGRown(pc[q])))
      /\ (AGSent(p,q) => (interrupt[q] \/ AGRblocked(pc[q])))
      /\ (AGQuiesced(p,q) => AGBlocked(q))
\* Outside a refresh interval, an unchecked stale TLB is permitted only
\* for a notified, blocked processor.  The responder's clear/unlock stages
\* retain coherence even while a notification is pending.
AGCoherent ==
  \A p \in Processor :
    (pc[p] # Boot /\ ~AGDirty(p) /\
      (~actionneeded[p] \/ ~AGBlocked(p) \/ pc[p] \in {ResponderClearActionNeeded, ResponderUnlockAction}))
    => tlb[p] = pentry[userpmap[p]]
AGInv == AGTypes /\ AGActivity /\ AGPmap /\ AGAction /\ AGTarget /\ AGNotify /\ AGCoherent /\ ~error

USE DEF Boot, MainCheck, MainChoose, MainHandleInterrupt, InitiatorDeactivate, InitiatorLockPmap,
    InitiatorForSend, InitiatorCheckCpuPmap, InitiatorLockAction, InitiatorSetActionNeeded,
    InitiatorUnlockAction, InitiatorInterrupt, InitiatorWaitForQuiescence, InitiatorUpdateEntry,
    InitiatorMaybeRefreshOwnTlb, InitiatorUnlockPmap, InitiatorReactivate, ResponderCheck,
    ResponderDeactivate, ResponderLockAction, ResponderRefreshTlb, ResponderClearActionNeeded,
    ResponderUnlockAction, ResponderReactivate

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Safety == SafetySpec => []NoError
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_tlb/ivy_examples_tlb_Safety.tla
PROOF
<1>1. Init => AGInv
  BY SMTT("r30") DEF Init, AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGAfterSend,
      AGAfterWait, AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGRblocked, AGBlocked, AGDirty, AGSent, AGMarked, AGQuiesced,
      AGTypes, AGActivity, AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify, AGCoherent, AGInv
\* Preserve the invariant separately for every concrete transition.
\* Substeps 1--7 preserve its structural conjuncts; substep 8 preserves
\* the assertion that none of the protocol's error checks has failed.
<1>2. ASSUME NEW p \in Processor, NEW m \in PMap, AGInv, BootProcessor(p, m)
        PROVE AGInv'
  <2> USE <1>2 DEF AGInv, BootProcessor
  <2>1. (AGTypes)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGTypes
  <2>2. (AGActivity)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGTypes, AGActivity
  <2>3. (AGPmap)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGTypes, AGPmap
  <2>4. (AGAction)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGTypes, AGPmap, AGAction,
        AGTarget
  <2>5. (AGTarget)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGTypes, AGTarget
  <2>6. (AGNotify)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGAfterSend, AGAfterWait,
        AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGRblocked, AGBlocked, AGSent, AGMarked, AGQuiesced, AGTypes, AGActivity,
        AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify
  <2>7. (AGCoherent)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGAfterSend, AGAfterWait,
        AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGRblocked, AGBlocked, AGDirty, AGSent, AGMarked, AGQuiesced, AGTypes,
        AGActivity, AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify, AGCoherent
  <2>8. (~error)'
    BY SMTT("r1")
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8 DEF AGInv
<1>3. ASSUME NEW p \in Processor, AGInv, MainCheckTlb(p)
        PROVE AGInv'
  <2> USE <1>3 DEF AGInv, MainCheckTlb
  <2>1. (AGTypes)'
    <3>1. error' = error
      BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGIinactive, AGRblocked,
          AGBlocked, AGDirty, AGTypes, AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGCoherent
    <3> QED BY <3>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AGTypes
  <2>2. (AGActivity)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGTypes, AGActivity
  <2>3. (AGPmap)'

  <2>4. (AGAction)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGTypes, AGPmap, AGAction,
        AGTarget
  <2>5. (AGTarget)'

  <2>6. (AGNotify)'

        AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify
  <2>7. (AGCoherent)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGAfterSend, AGAfterWait,
        AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGRblocked, AGBlocked, AGDirty, AGSent, AGMarked, AGQuiesced, AGTypes,
        AGActivity, AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify, AGCoherent
  <2>8. (~error)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGIinactive, AGRblocked,
        AGBlocked, AGDirty, AGTypes, AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGCoherent
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8 DEF AGInv
<1>4. ASSUME NEW p \in Processor, AGInv, ChooseInitiator(p)
        PROVE AGInv'
  <2> USE <1>4 DEF AGInv, ChooseInitiator
  <2>1. (AGTypes)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGTypes
  <2>2. (AGActivity)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGTypes, AGActivity
  <2>3. (AGPmap)'

  <2>4. (AGAction)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGTypes, AGPmap, AGAction,
        AGTarget
  <2>5. (AGTarget)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGTypes, AGTarget
  <2>6. (AGNotify)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGAfterSend, AGAfterWait,
        AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGRblocked, AGBlocked, AGSent, AGMarked, AGQuiesced, AGTypes, AGActivity,
        AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify
  <2>7. (AGCoherent)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGAfterSend, AGAfterWait,

        AGActivity, AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify, AGCoherent
  <2>8. (~error)'
    BY SMTT("r1")
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8 DEF AGInv

        PROVE AGInv'
  <2> USE <1>5 DEF AGInv, SkipInitiator
  <2>1. (AGTypes)'

  <2>2. (AGActivity)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGTypes, AGActivity
  <2>3. (AGPmap)'

  <2>4. (AGAction)'
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGPheld, AGSending, AGSelected, AGMatching, AGIown, AGRown, AGTypes, AGPmap, AGAction,

  <2>5. (AGTarget)'

  <2>1. (AGTypes)'

  <2>2. (AGActivity)'

  <2>3. (AGPmap)'

  <2>4. (AGAction)'

  <2>5. (AGTarget)'

        AGIinactive, AGRinactive, AGRblocked, AGBlocked, AGSent, AGMarked, AGQuiesced, AGTypes, AGActivity,
        AGPmap, AGAction, AGTarget, AGNotify

  <2>1. (AGTypes)'

  <2>2. (AGActivity)'

    <3>2. \A q \in Processor : AGIown(pc'[q]) => actionlock'[currentcpu'[q]]

  <2>1. (AGTypes)'
    <3>1. todo' \in [Processor -> [Processor -> BOOLEAN]]
      BY SMTT("r5") DEF AGTypes
